title: Urban flood resilience
intro: Compare the observed baseline with a proposed adoption scenario for this market.
visual.aria: Diagram: the observed baseline is shown next to the user-controlled adoption scenario. The scenario control changes the proposed adoption rate, not the measured baseline.
explainer: Urban flood resilience: how to read the simulation
explainer.lead: The diagram separates what was observed from the assumption you choose. It does not measure the proposed outcome.
